typescript: JavaScript with static typing and safe refactors.
javascript: The base language of the web, in the browser and on the server.
nextjs: React framework with SSR, routing and build optimization.
react-native: iOS and Android mobile apps with the React stack.
html: Semantic, accessible markup as the foundation of pages.
css: Responsive layout, animations and design systems.
mui: React component library with a customizable theme.
vite: Instant dev server and optimized builds for the frontend.
node: JavaScript runtime for APIs and back-end services.
express: Minimalist framework for REST APIs in Node.
fastify: High-performance Node framework with schema validation and plugins.
graphql: Query language for APIs with a typed schema and on-demand fetching.
php: Server-side language in web and legacy systems.
laravel: PHP framework with ORM, queues and authentication out of the box.
csharp: .NET platform language for APIs and services.
mysql: Relational database: modeling, queries and indexes.
docker: Containers to standardize environments and deploys.
aws: Cloud infrastructure: compute, storage and queues.
azure: Microsoft's cloud for .NET apps and pipelines.
grafana: Dashboards and alerts for metrics and logs observability.
datadog: Observability with metrics, logs and alerts.
git: Version control, branches and change history.
github: Repositories, code review and CI with Actions.
jest: Unit and integration tests with coverage.
cypress: End-to-end tests running in a real browser.
swagger: API documentation in the OpenAPI standard.
postman: Collections to test and document endpoints.
insomnia: REST and GraphQL client for debugging requests.
beekeeper: SQL client to explore and edit databases.
vscode: Everyday editor — and the inspiration for this site.
